summary: 面向 GUI 的 refs-first Computer Use action loop；真实桌面完成必须由 host-provided target-bound ports 和 evidence 证明。

entrypoint.productRoute: Agent Host -> WindowActionSession -> TypeScript host-port contract -> current evidence bundle
entrypoint.notes: Computer Use product/default acceptance is TS-only and consumes refs-first host ports plus WindowAction evidence projection.

legacyPythonImplementation.scriptLabelRequirement: Every package.json script that invokes this implementation must include opt-in, diagnostic, legacy, or historical in the script name or command.
legacyPythonImplementation.claimLimit: Python files are legacy-obsolete and cannot be referenced by product/default acceptance. These commands may be used only for isolated historical diagnostics, package-local regression archaeology, or manual compatibility probes.

examples.task: 点击目标窗口中可见的搜索框

environmentTargets.isolation: 观察、坐标映射和执行都必须绑定目标窗口或窗口内容坐标。
远程会话必须隔离输入通道和 trace。

safetyGates.notes: 旧实现中 high risk action 在 fail-closed 策略下返回 needs-confirmation，不执行。

executorAdapterContract.bindingClaimLimit: Target binding validation is required for real desktop preflight readiness, but is not B/C/verifier completion evidence.

nativeMultiScreenSidecarProtocol.claimLimit: The native multi-screen live runner may use DOM/AX/Playwright refs only as grounding hints and may mark M6 completed only as historical opt-in regression/diagnostic evidence when capabilities/discovery plus preflight/capture/state/execute are all non-diagnostic current-bundle evidence; it cannot set userAcceptanceEligible=true or satisfy virtual-app-screen-user-acceptance without a separate manifest.

hostPortsContract.notes: Computer Use action provider consumes host-owned platform ports. It never imports GUI implementation and never opens confirmation UI directly.

virtualDisplayProviderContract.claimLimit: The virtual display provider contract proves catalog/probe/readiness/invoke boundaries only. It is legacy compatibility evidence and cannot replace the TypeScript WindowActionSession product path, current evidence bundle, action causality, verifier refs, or Host completion.

nativeToolsContract.productionHost: TypeScript host adapter via Agent Host WindowActionSession and refs-first host ports

mcpServer.configRef: manual-legacy-diagnostic-only; repo default .mcp.json intentionally omits this server

nativeToolsContract.claimLimit: This is a package-local debug/native-tool contract. It never executes GUI actions itself; real mutating input still requires a host-bound scoped executor adapter.

requiredNativeSurfaces: native multi-screen/multi-actor cursor historical opt-in regression

nativeProductGatePolicy.productionHost: Agent Host WindowActionSession via TypeScript host-port adapter

passedRequires: gui.present refs when presentation is requested

legacyBackendPackaging.rdp: legacy or future sidecar backend packaging only

publicSurfaceParity.claimLimit: This parity block keeps the action manifest aligned with the TS-only product route. WindowActionSession current evidence is the active Computer Use product gate; VirtualAppScreen, M6/native multi-screen, Docker/noVNC/RDP, and Python probes are retained only as legacy, historical, opt-in, or diagnostic evidence and cannot be the product owner.

platformSidecarContract.claimLimit: Platform sidecar L0 backend returns refs, permission preflight, isolation report and scheduler-lease-bound executor events only. It cannot perform planning, provider ranking, GUI presentation, workspace write policy or user-level completion.

isolatedDesktopBackendRuntime.claimLimit: The Docker/noVNC/RDP bundle spec only records reproducible backend packaging, readiness, and historical diagnostic commands. It is not an active Computer Use product gate, concurrency model, or running backend by itself; native product acceptance must come through the app-server/native plugin surface plus current refs-first evidence.

plannerContract.output: exactly one generic action or done=true
plannerContract.notes: Planner must not output coordinates, app-private shortcuts, unsupported action types, or empty action blocks.

traceContract.retention: trace 只保存 refs、紧凑摘要和结构化步骤，大 payload 进入 artifact store。

validationOptions.requireExistingRefs: optional boolean; when true result, trace, screenshot, observation, artifact, and probe refs must point to existing local files

repairManifestContract.claimLimit: Blocked repair manifests are refs-first failure diagnostics. Package-local failures with realWindowEvidence=false must remain diagnosticOnly=true and cannot be promoted into real-window success evidence.

validationOptions.requireExistingRefs: optional boolean; when true source failure, replay result, and replay trace refs must point to existing local files

repairReplayContract.claimLimit: Package-local repair replay evidence can validate disambiguation replay plumbing only; realWindowEvidence=false cannot close PROJECT C or B and is unrelated to verifier completion.

validationOptions.requireExistingRefs: optional boolean; when true source failure, replay result, replay trace, and scroll state refs must point to existing local files

viewportRecoveryContract.claimLimit: Package-local viewport recovery evidence can validate offscreen scroll recovery plumbing only; realWindowEvidence=false cannot close PROJECT C or B and is unrelated to verifier completion.

workflowRequirements.minimumActionCount: optional integer; Task B real-window evidence uses at least 6
workflowRequirements.requiredInputModalities: optional array of pointer and/or keyboard; validator must read both resolved result/trace steps and target-bound input event refs, including targetPointerStateRef, targetKeyboardStateRef, targetInputEventLogRef or their pointer/keyboard/inputEventLogRef aliases
workflowRequirements.requiresCurrentStepScreenshots: optional boolean; when true each step must carry a current screenshot or observation ref
workflowRequirements.forbidPriorRoundCompletionEvidence: optional boolean; when true prior-round ledger/historical done markers are rejected
workflowRequirements.requiresDirectoryEvidence: optional boolean; when true fileListArtifactRef and fileListDataRef must be present and visible in result/trace refs

declaredArtifactOutput.pptxValidationRef: written next to the final .pptx artifact when a slide-deck artifact is saved
declaredArtifactOutput.docxValidationRef: written next to the final .docx artifact when a word-document artifact is saved
declaredArtifactOutput.causalityPolicy: When artifact metadata is present, finalArtifactRef must match evidence finalArtifactRef, savedByActionIndex must point to a generic save or Ctrl/Cmd+S action, and the save action must have a matching keyboard event.

targetBoundRealWindowProbeContract.claimLimit: This contract validates refs from an actual target-bound package diagnostic run. The package-owned target-bound window host can produce package-level real-window evidence only when its run writes ready preflight, target binding validation, initial/final screenshots, trace/result refs, inputExecuted=true, and no OS/shared/system input side effects. It cannot claim L1/L2/L3 or userAcceptanceEligible=true.

workflowRequirements.minimumActionCount: at least 4 generic state-changing steps: open_app, click/focus input, type_text, click button/control
workflowRequirements.requiresViewerRealFrames: viewer validation must report at least two screenshot frames; placeholder-only viewers are diagnostic
workflowRequirements.requiresScreenshotContentChange: initialScreenshotRef and finalScreenshotRef must point to non-empty local files with different sha256 content when existing refs validation is enabled
workflowRequirements.requiresStepwiseScreenshotContentChange: each state-changing L1 step must have distinct before/after screenshot refs with different file content when existing refs validation is enabled
workflowRequirements.requiresPreflightPayloadValidation: preflightRef must resolve to the isolated desktop backend probe schema with status=ready, Linux platform, matching backend kind, required observed components, noVncWebRoot and all preflightChecks ok; L1 permits backend-probe diagnosticOnly=true as dependency readiness only, but rejects readinessOnly, executeFailClosed and shape-only preflight payloads
workflowRequirements.requiresBackendReadinessProof: backendReadinessProofRef must resolve to a ready linux-novnc-libreoffice-browser proof with localhost-only VNC endpoint, localhost noVNC HTTP viewer proof and no shared system input side effects
workflowRequirements.requiresXDisplayReadinessProof: backendReadinessProofRef.xDisplay must prove isolated DISPLAY is queryable through xdotool getdisplaygeometry, has positive geometry, matches the requested L1 viewport and has no shared/system input side effects
workflowRequirements.requiresBrowserWindowPageReadinessProof: backendReadinessProofRef.desktopWindow and page must prove the browser exposed a visible ready window title through isolated xdotool search/getwindowgeometry before L1 input begins
workflowRequirements.requiresNoVncHttpViewerProof: backendReadinessProofRef.novnc.httpViewer must prove GET /vnc.html from localhost returned 2xx/3xx HTML with noVNC marker, bytesRead, sha256 and rawPayloadWritten=false
workflowRequirements.requiresWindowBoundPointerProof: targetWindowRef and windowBoundPointerProofRef must prove every pointer click is dispatched in window coordinate space with --window, target bounds hit-testing, command provenance and no shared/system input side effects
workflowRequirements.requiresExecutorCommandProvenance: executorCommandEventLogRef must resolve to package-local isolated input executor command events; every pointer/keyboard input event must cite a successful command event with matching actionIndex, modality and isolated DISPLAY
workflowRequirements.requiresRuntimeProcessProof: processRef must resolve to sciforge.computer-use.backend-processes.v1, match backendReadinessProofRef.processRef, cover virtual-display/window-manager/vnc-server/novnc-proxy/browser roles with existing stdoutLogRef and stderrLogRef files, bind to the isolated DISPLAY, match sessionId when session refs declare one and carry explicit false shared/system side-effect flags
workflowRequirements.requiresRuntimeResourceAllocation: resourceAllocationRef must resolve to the isolated runtime allocation schema, prove per-run display plus VNC/noVNC localhost ports instead of fixed defaults, match backendReadinessProofRef VNC/noVNC ports when present, match sessionId when session refs declare one and carry explicit false shared/system side-effect flags
workflowRequirements.requiresProcessLogRefs: long-running backend/browser process records must expose stdoutLogRef and stderrLogRef instead of undrained pipes
workflowRequirements.requiresContainerSafeBrowserLaunch: Chromium-family source app launch must suppress first-run/background UI and use --no-sandbox when running as root in isolated containers
workflowRequirements.requiresCurrentCompletionClaim: evidence ledger must contain a current completion-claim whose supports are current records, including the final screenshot observation

isolatedDesktopL1SmokeContract.claimLimit: Readiness manifests and package-owned target-bound diagnostics cannot satisfy L1. Completed L1 evidence must come from a real isolated Linux noVNC desktop run with remote-desktop isolated input, current screenshots, viewer refs, input logs, trace/result refs, evidence ledger refs, and side-effect flags proving no shared system input.

workflowRequirements.requiresInputActionIndexCoverage: pointer and keyboard input event logs must cite every workflow action index that uses the corresponding required modality
workflowRequirements.actionPlanPolicy: L3 runners use a diagnostic-only refs-first source -> writer -> save -> preview -> validate action plan with monotonic actionIndex values, expected modalities, and required screenshot/observation refs before executing GUI input
workflowRequirements.completionAssemblyPolicy: L3 runners must validate completed L3 evidence with require_existing_refs=true before writing completionEvidenceRef; blocked assembly manifests cannot complete L3 and partial namespace refs cannot be promoted
workflowRequirements.runnerExecutionBoundaryPolicy: when L3 --execute prerequisites are ready, the probe writes runnerExecutionBoundaryRef for GUI-only phase gates, artifact policy, input policy, same-session policy and required completed refs; success is promoted only after completed evidence validates
workflowRequirements.partialRuntimeRefsPolicy: partialRunRef and partialRuntimeRefs may prove same-session runtime launch only; they are diagnostic, not requiredRefs, and cannot satisfy completed L3 evidence. Partial executorCommandEventLogRef must remain a no-workflow-input diagnostic log with eventCount=0 and events=[]; file-preview process records may use launcher-completed only to show that a directory preview launcher request returned successfully.
workflowRequirements.requiresPreflightPayloadValidation: preflightRef must resolve to a ready Linux isolated desktop backend payload with backendKind, platform, observed backend components, noVNC web root and no diagnostic/readiness-only/fail-closed markers
workflowRequirements.requiresSameSessionRuntimeRefs: sessionManifestRef, virtualDisplayRef, captureStreamRef, replayBundleRef and noVncViewerRef must share session/display identity; noVNC must be localhost-only and captureStreamRef.frameRefs must contain workflow screenshots
workflowRequirements.requiresSessionBoundRuntimeProofs: processRef and resourceAllocationRef must include sessionId/display values that match sessionManifestRef and virtualDisplayRef
workflowRequirements.requiresBackendReadinessProof: backendReadinessProofRef must resolve to ready Linux/noVNC runtime proof with localhost-only VNC/noVNC HTTP viewer, queryable isolated X display and no shared/system input side effects
workflowRequirements.requiresExecutorCommandProvenance: executorCommandEventLogRef must cite successful isolated input executor commands for every pointer/keyboard workflow action index, with matching modality, DISPLAY, returncode and no shared/system side-effect flags
workflowRequirements.requiresRuntimeResourceAllocation: resourceAllocationRef must prove per-run isolated DISPLAY plus VNC/noVNC localhost ports were allocated for this L3 run
workflowRequirements.requiresProcessLogRefs: processRef must expose long-running backend/app process records with stdout/stderr log refs
workflowRequirements.requiresWindowBoundPointerProof: targetWindowRef and windowBoundPointerProofRef must prove every L3 pointer click is dispatched in window coordinate space with --window, target bounds hit-testing, command provenance and no shared/system input side effects
workflowRequirements.requiresScreenshotContentDiversity: existing screenshot refs must contain at least three distinct file hashes across source, writer, and file-preview states
workflowRequirements.requiresGuiSavedArtifactCausality: artifactCausality must cite finalArtifactRef, artifactValidationRef, savedThroughGui=true, shellDirectArtifactWrite=false and savedByCommandEventRef matching the keyboard save input event
workflowRequirements.requiresGuiDirectoryPreviewCausality: directoryEvidence must cite previewedThroughGui=true, shellDirectoryListingOnly=false and previewedByActionIndex matching pointer input evidence for the file preview
workflowRequirements.requiresSupportedFactContentInArtifact: supported source fact payloads must resolve to source-fact schema with non-empty fact text, and artifactValidationRef textRuns/normalized text must include every supported fact
workflowRequirements.sourceFactEvidencePolicy: source fact helpers are refs-first diagnostics for source observation -> supported fact -> derived content; they cannot claim completion or user acceptance
workflowRequirements.artifactBundleEvidencePolicy: artifact bundle helpers are refs-first diagnostics for final artifact, artifact validation, file-list, preview and gui.present refs; they cannot claim completion or user acceptance

isolatedDesktopL3WorkflowContract.claimLimit: This contract/validator governs real isolated L3 multi-app evidence. The L3 workflow probe may write completionEvidenceRef only when validate_isolated_desktop_l3_workflow_evidence(require_existing_refs=true) accepts existing refs from the same isolated virtual session; target-bound diagnostics, partialRunRef and partialRuntimeRefs cannot be copied into completed top-level requiredRefs or traceRefs. Completed L3 must load existing refs proving source reader, writer, file preview, artifact validation, directory evidence, visible viewer, input logs, window-bound pointer proof, runtime resource allocation proof, evidence ledger, and the same isolated virtual session.

semanticVerifierProbeContract.configSourcePolicy: Reads ignored local visionLLM config only; manifests may record config refs, model id, and URL origin but never API keys.
semanticVerifierProbeContract.completionVerdictPolicy: Provider output must parse to JSON with verdict=pass before the probe status can become completed; fail, unknown, or non-JSON output writes a blocked manifest.
semanticVerifierProbeContract.modelsDiagnosticPolicy: The /models diagnostic may summarize body kind, bytes read, model count, and whether the configured model is present; it must not persist raw model ids or raw response bodies.
semanticVerifierProbeContract.projectEvidenceEligibilityPolicy: A completed semantic verifier probe is a PROJECT verifier eligible evidence candidate only when the configured model is in projectEvidenceModels, the provider response model does not contradict it, and /models diagnostics verify configuredModelPresent=true.
semanticVerifierProbeContract.transportFallback: Uses a package-local raw HTTP/1.1 non-streaming transport for Chat/Responses candidates and diagnostics, with urllib retained as fallback for retryable raw transport failures.
semanticVerifierProbeContract.claimLimit: Package-local fake HTTP provider tests and provider diagnostics validate wire-shape and refs-first metadata; PROJECT verifier evidence is eligible only after a real projectEvidenceModels provider call returns a completed refs-first semantic verifier summary with model presence verified.

semanticVerifierPolicy.fakeOrDiagnosticOnlyClaimLimit: A fake provider or diagnostic-only semantic summary cannot own execution, coordinates, completion, or artifact-producing success.
